scope: All69 native component families sufficiently described as source references, with appropriate bounded completeness profiles, independent source export classification and representative executable behavior. No universal product or AT certification.

domainReview.interface: Every actual exported React component/public alias mapped in CEM; visual class factories and TS-only types explicitly classified against source AST. DatePicker/DataTable remain exact documented compositions.
domainReview.visual: All69 FIG/PNG/receipts and source IDs audited;1512 native token measurement nodes, native CSS observations and unchanged prior semantic token values.65 new PNG regenerated from readback with graph-isolated renderer and reviewed contact sheets.
domainReview.behavior: Every current69 SCXML machine hash matches executed bounded protocol evidence. Original callback/native-event/updater identities and distinct controlled authorities remain explicit; actual primitive handles detailed algorithms.
domainReview.accessibility: Native HTML/ARIA reference instances, meaningful names/relations and semantic counterexamples; real source runtime focus/keyboard/disabled/error behavior checked at representative compositions.
domainReview.integration: Source/root IDs, native variants, source4408 byte hashes,4184 installed runtime files,62 compiled input/output pairs,432 public export classifications and completed evidence bindings independently checked.

decisions: Supported CalendarDayButton focus-ref caller adapter repairs verified upstream omission; unchanged raw source and repaired disabled-day/month-boundary behavior separately preserved.
Tooltip is visual-only in selected upstream; essential descriptions remain persistent and independent. Native naming is not replaced with gratuitous ARIA.
Sidebar controlled desktop callback/cookie and mobile Sheet state are independent; Trigger preventDefault does not veto source toggle.
Table and chart content retain complete readable native data; no fake spreadsheet/selected-chart behavior is introduced.
HTML/CSS projections alone do not claim a functioning Base UI adapter; executable target uses bound original React wrappers.

preservation.historicalSnapshots: Original history bytes retained, with explicit hash-bound archive-origin contexts for portable-copy link rebasing.

limitations: Sufficient four-domain source reference and representative executable checks, not universal runtime, every prop combination, cross-platform or assistive-technology certification.
HTML/CSS projections are semantic/design evidence, not standalone functioning Base UI adapters. Actual source runtime is separately bound.
Calendar uses an explicit supported focus-ref adapter; raw pinned upstream defect and repaired month-boundary behavior are both preserved.
Static native visual review does not establish Figma pixel identity or export additional icon distributions.
